description: Paste a report excerpt, alert or article (up to 4000 characters) and get the ThreatNexus-tracked actors it names, using the same evidence-gated resolver ThreatNexus uses on its own ingest — designators such as "APT34" count on sight, weaker aliases only with naming context. Each match links to its dossier. A name in a text is a mention, not an attribution.

text.description: The text to scan. Sent to ThreatNexus for this lookup only; it is not stored or logged.

name: identify_actors_in_text
title: Which tracked actors a text names
